exec > >(tee -a /tmp/build.log) 2>&1
VERSION=""

# a) Project pakai FVM? Ya tinggal ikutin
if [ -f .fvmrc ]; then
  VERSION=$(jq -r '.flutter // empty' .fvmrc 2>/dev/null || true)
elif [ -f .fvm/fvm_config.json ]; then
  VERSION=$(jq -r '.flutterSdkVersion // empty' .fvm/fvm_config.json 2>/dev/null || true)
fi

# b) Kalau nggak ada, baca revision dari .metadata terus cocokin ke tag rilis Flutter
if [ -z "$VERSION" ] && [ -f .metadata ]; then
  REV=$(grep -m1 -E '^[[:space:]]*revision:' .metadata | sed -E 's/.*revision:[[:space:]]*"?([0-9a-f]{7,40})"?.*/\1/' || true)
  if [ -n "$REV" ]; then
    echo "Revision Flutter dari .metadata: $REV"
    VERSION=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git \
      | awk -v r="$REV" 'index($1, r)==1 && $2 ~ /refs\/tags\/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\^\{\})?$/ {print $2}' \
      | sed -E 's#refs/tags/##; s#\^\{\}##' | head -n 1 || true)
  fi
fi

# Bersihin awalan "v" kalau ada
VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
if [ -n "$VERSION" ]; then
  echo "Versi Flutter project: $VERSION"
else
  echo "Versi Flutter project nggak ketahuan, pakai stable terbaru"
fi
echo "flutter_version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# c) Gradle project lama (< 7.3) nggak jalan di Java 17, jadi pakai Java 11
JAVA=17
GV=$(grep -oE 'gradle-[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | sed 's/gradle-//' || true)
if [ -n "$GV" ]; then
  GMAJOR=${GV%%.*}
  GMINOR=${GV#*.}
  if [ "$GMAJOR" -lt 7 ] || { [ "$GMAJOR" -eq 7 ] && [ "$GMINOR" -lt 3 ]; }; then
    JAVA=11
  fi
  echo "Gradle project: $GV"
fi
echo "Java dipakai: $JAVA"
echo "java_version=$JAVA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
